exam.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends six months of hands-on experience. Working Python, scikit-learn, Spark ML, statistics, data preparation, Unity Catalog feature/model governance, MLflow, evaluation and batch/stream/real-time inference are practical prerequisites.

review.notes: The March 1, 2025 detailed live-version PDF and current four-domain page were reconciled. The guide explicitly maps the live ML Workflows label to the PDF's Data Processing objectives and distinguishes live assessment metadata from the older PDF. Three scenarios, eight labs and 32 original checks cover MLOps/runtime/AutoML; Unity Catalog feature tables and MLflow tracking/registry; profiling/outliers/imputation/encoding/log transforms; algorithm/pipeline/imbalance/tuning/CV/metrics/bias-variance; and batch/stream/real-time deployment with canary evidence. All 16 guide URLs are cataloged: 15 reachable and Udemy search automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Aged Delta Live Tables, workspace registry, Hyperopt and serving terminology is preserved as published and translated through current documentation; vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced.

findings.title: AutoML packaging boundary absent from preparation advice
findings.evidence: Runtime 18.0 ML and later omit the built-in AutoML library.
findings.recommendation: Add specific environment preflight without claiming the service disappeared.
findings.resolution: Add specific environment preflight without claiming the service disappeared.

findings.title: Hyperopt legacy objective lacked actionable support context
findings.evidence: Runtime ML stops bundling Hyperopt after 16.4 LTS ML; objective still names fmin.
findings.recommendation: Preserve scope, explain minimization/choice decoding and separate newer practice alternatives.
findings.resolution: Preserve scope, explain minimization/choice decoding and separate newer practice alternatives.

findings.title: Alias movement could be mistaken for endpoint rollback
findings.evidence: Registry alias resolution and an endpoint configuration update are separate operations.
findings.recommendation: Explain loaded-object and endpoint boundaries and fix the fraud scenario.
findings.resolution: Explain loaded-object and endpoint boundaries and fix the fraud scenario.

findings.title: Feature primary-key declaration could imply enforcement
findings.evidence: Primary key constraints are informational; point-in-time joins also require a timestamp contract.
findings.recommendation: Add uniqueness checks and worked temporal example with availability caveat.
findings.resolution: Add uniqueness checks and worked temporal example with availability caveat.

findings.title: Preprocessing and search guidance lacked executable evidence
findings.evidence: Fitted preprocessing must exclude held-out rows and be fitted separately within each CV fold.
findings.recommendation: Add executed synthetic pipeline and negative leakage control with observed fit counts.
findings.resolution: Add executed synthetic pipeline and negative leakage control with observed fit counts.
